manualReviews.finding: 4 accesses comprise 3 writes and 1 SELECT, not 4 writes.
manualReviews.firstGap: No field-level or filter-value origin record; input conversions are String/Number/trim/coalescing/boolean comparison, not validation or authorization.
manualReviews.auth: No user auth or owner column observed; declared public data intent is not an IDOR label.

manualReviews.firstGap: External getServerProfile helper, variable map/reduce payloads and UPSERT are outside the proposed first direct-origin contract.
manualReviews.partialCandidate: app/api/retrieval/process/docx/route.ts:11-12 -> UPDATE filter :108; this is request-derived fileId, not a verified user ID.

manualReviews.firstGap: authActionClient wrapper is not a registered Next request entry; extended alias and helper selection limits are distinct barriers.
Writes in helper module do not have a direct Next request declaration; webhook signature success is not modeled.
Admin mutations are helper declarations without request-to-write identity evidence; absence of association is not proof of vulnerability.

findings.title: 사용자별 수정 권한이 넓게 선언되어 있습니다
findings.reason: 명시적 쓰기 권한과 행 접근 선언에서 사용자별 제한이 없는 작업 또는 UPDATE의 기존 행·변경 후 행 중 한쪽만 제한된 작업을 확인했습니다. 의도적인 공유 데이터인지와 운영 적용 상태는 별도 확인이 필요합니다.
findings.recommendation: 공유 데이터인지 먼저 확인하고, 사용자 전용 데이터라면 해당 작업의 기존 행 조건(USING)과 새 행 조건(WITH CHECK)에 실제 소유자 컬럼과 auth.uid() 비교를 적용하세요. 여러 permissive 정책과 GRANT도 함께 검토하세요.
verificationSteps: 격리 테스트 환경에서 사용자 A·B의 조회·수정·삭제와 소유자 변경을 각각 확인하세요.
익명 사용자와 관리자 경로를 따로 검사하고 실제 적용 migration·GRANT·역할을 대조한 뒤 재검사하세요.

failureCasePack.fix: Bounded local source origins attached only after a direct Next declaration and Client origin link. Payload fields and existing-row filters are separate. No new risk finding.
failureCasePack.validation: write_origin_validation_extra.mjs; same author, truth frozen before first run, 7/8 classifications match
failureCasePack.remainingFailure: Two-step static payload alias remains UNKNOWN; earlier ID argument use retains conservative escape boundary.

limitations: Local source classification is not a vulnerability TP/FN/precision/recall metric.
Grade C applications have no whole-project safe/vulnerable truth; absence of findings is not TN.
Code evidence from getUser/getClaims and absence exits does not prove runtime authentication or database role.
Write fields and row filters are independent; field names do not establish the ownership model.
Same-author controls and validation are not independent blind/external evaluation.
Two-step payload-object alias and earlier ID argument use can conservatively remain UNKNOWN.
Helpers, dynamic wrappers, UPSERT, arrays and additional query/params extraction were not added.
PostgreSQL oracle receipts are inherited from validation #9; no external SQL or database executed here.
Resource measurements are parsed subset Worker replay, not whole-backend peak RSS or full SQL execution.
Mock GitHub regression and real H2/React browser tests are not live GitHub App validation.
